table.retrieve:
SELECT
	GroupName=  
		CASE :as_reportgrouping
		WHEN 'M' THEN (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE  = I.ManfCode)
		WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE  = I.ICatCode)
		WHEN 'L' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE  = I.ICCode)
		ELSE (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE  = I.PACKCODE) END,   
	Doctype = 'SV-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SL.SALEINVCODE, 10))), 
	SL.DATE,
	InvCode=SL.SaleInvCode,
	Type='S',
	CustomerAliasName=A.AliasName,
	Customer=A.Name,
	SD.ICode,
	I.Name,
	I.CustomICode,
	Batch = SD.Batch, 
	Qty=SUM(SD.LooseQty),
	Bonus=SUM(SD.BonusQty),
	NetRate = MAX((SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * 
			(1 - SD.DiscPerc * .01) * (1 - SL.DiscPerc * .01)) / (SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty)),
	CGS=SUM((SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty) * SD.AVGPRICE), 
	SalePreson=SM.Name
FROM
	SaleLedger SL, SaleDetail SD, Accounts A, Item I, SalesMan SM
WHERE
	SL.Date BETWEEN :ar_StartDate AND :ar_EndDate AND
	SL.CustCode IN (:ar_CustCode) AND
	SL.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND
	SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
	SL.SManCode = SM.SalesManCode AND
	CASE :as_reportgrouping
	WHEN 'M' THEN I.manfcode
	WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
	WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
	ELSE I.PACKCODE END IN (:ll_groupcode) AND
	SD.GCode = case :as_AllGodown WHEN 'Y' THEN SD.GCode ELSE :ai_gcode end
GROUP BY
	SL.DATE,
	SL.SaleInvCode,
	SD.ICode, 
	I.Name, 
	I.CustomICode,
	I.ManfCode,
	I.ICatCode,
	I.ICCode,
	I.PackCode,
	SD.Batch,
	SD.SalePrice,
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name, 
	SM.Name
UNION ALL
SELECT
	GroupName=  
		CASE :as_reportgrouping
		WHEN 'M' THEN (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE  = I.ManfCode)
		WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE  = I.ICatCode)
		WHEN 'L' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE  = I.ICCode)
		ELSE (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE  = I.PACKCODE) END,   
	Doctype = 'SV-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SL.SALEINVCODE, 10))), 
	SL.DATE,
	InvCode=SL.SaleInvCode,
	Type='S',
	CustomerAliasName=A.AliasName,
	Customer=A.Name,
	SD.ICode,
	I.Name,
	I.CustomICode,
	Batch = SD.Batch,
	Qty=SUM(SD.LooseQty),
	Bonus=SUM(SD.BonusQty),
	NetRate = MAX((SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * 
			(1 - SD.DiscPerc * .01) * (1 - SL.DiscPerc * .01)) / (SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty)),
	CGS=SUM((SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty) * SD.AVGPRICE), 
	SalePreson=SM.Name
FROM
	SaleLedger SL, SaleInvDetail SD, Accounts A, Item I, SalesMan SM
WHERE
	SL.ImpactInventory = 'N' AND
	SL.Date BETWEEN :ar_StartDate AND :ar_EndDate AND
	SL.CustCode IN (:ar_CustCode) AND
	SL.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND
	SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
	SL.SManCode = SM.SalesManCode AND
	CASE :as_reportgrouping
	WHEN 'M' THEN I.manfcode
	WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
	WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
	ELSE I.PACKCODE END IN (:ll_groupcode) AND
	SD.GCode = case :as_AllGodown WHEN 'Y' THEN SD.GCode ELSE :ai_gcode end
GROUP BY
	SL.DATE,
	SL.SaleInvCode,
	SD.ICode, 
	I.Name, 
	I.CustomICode,
	I.ManfCode,
	I.ICatCode,
	I.ICCode,
	I.PackCode,
	SD.Batch,
	SD.SalePrice,
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name, 
	SM.Name
UNION ALL
SELECT
	GroupName=  
		CASE :as_reportgrouping
		WHEN 'M' THEN (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE  = I.ManfCode)
		WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE  = I.ICatCode)
		WHEN 'L' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE  = I.ICCode)
		ELSE (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE  = I.PACKCODE) END,   
	Doctype = 'SR-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SL.SRINVCODE, 10))), 
	SL.DATE,
	InvCode=SL.SRInvCode,
	Type='R',
	CustomerAliasName=A.AliasName,
	Customer=A.Name,
	SD.ICode, 
	I.Name, 
	I.CustomICode, 
	Batch = SD.Batch,
	Qty=-SUM(SD.LooseQty),
	Bonus=-SUM(SD.BonusQty),
	NetRate = MAX((SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * .01) * 
			(1 - SL.DiscPerc * .01)) / (SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty)),
	CGS=-SUM((SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty) * SD.AVGPRICE), 
	SalePreson=SM.Name
FROM
	SRLedger SL
	LEFT OUTER JOIN SalesMan SM ON (SL.SManCode = SM.SalesManCode),
	SRDetail SD, Accounts A, Item I
WHERE
	SL.Date BETWEEN :ar_StartDate AND :ar_EndDate AND
	SL.CustCode IN (:ar_CustCode) AND
	SL.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	SL.SRInvCode = SD.SRInvCode AND
	SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
	CASE :as_reportgrouping
	WHEN 'M' THEN I.manfcode
	WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
	WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
	ELSE I.PACKCODE END IN (:ll_groupcode) AND
	SD.GCode = case :as_AllGodown WHEN 'Y' THEN SD.GCode ELSE :ai_gcode end
GROUP BY
	SL.DATE,
	SL.SRInvCode,
	SD.ICode, 
	I.Name, 
	I.CustomICode,
	I.ManfCode,
	I.ICatCode,
	I.ICCode,
	I.PackCode,
	SD.Batch,
	SD.SRPrice,
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name, 
	SM.Name
/*
ORDER BY
	GroupName,
	I.Name, 
	I.CustomICode,
	DATE,
	InvCode,
	SD.Batch,
	NetRate,
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name, 
	SM.Name
*/
